state.label: ENSO-Neutral · El Niño Watch
state.detail: Neutral conditions persist but the ocean is warming fast. NOAA issued an El Niño Watch on May 14. Atmospheric coupling has begun but is not yet locked in.

narrative: ENSO remains neutral but ocean heat content is more than double the May-2023 reading and Niño 3.4 has crossed +0.5°C for the first time since May 2024. Forecast consensus favours El Niño emergence by July (82%) with a Super event the modal peak for Dec 2026–Feb 2027. The open question is sustainability: atmospheric coupling has started (SOI −0.3) but trade winds have not decisively weakened. Conditions resemble 1997 and 2015 on the ocean signal, but 2023 on the coupling signal — the latter peaked and faded. Watch the June 11 NOAA update and June–July trade winds.
